Green: **625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing** (exit 0).

**What was actually broken** — 3 failures out of 625, all in `order totals`, all one bug:

`src/pricing.js:39` `orderTotal` applied tax to the *pre-discount* base and added it on:

```js
const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);   // cents, not discounted
return discounted + tax;
```

Its own doc comment says tax is charged on what the customer actually pays. Fixed to tax the discounted amount:

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Why it hid: every other order-total row has either a 0% discount or a 0 tax rate, and with either at zero the two formulas agree. Only the three rows with both non-zero (`12000c/15%/8.25%`, `8650c/20%/5%`, `33400c/10%/20%`) could expose it. The other 8 suites were never failing — the wall of text was ~620 passing lines plus a coverage table.

I only changed the one function; no test or case data was touched.
